Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Madagascar has Law No. 2014-038 on Personal Data Protection (in force 2015) and ratified the Malabo Convention (2024). The CMIL was established in December 2023. A legal framework recommendation was provided by the Estonian e-Governance Academy for the X-Road implementation. These provide a legal basis for digital data exchange operations.

Comments: Madagascar's digital transformation roadmap was co-developed with Public Digital and includes interoperability as a defined pillar. Comments: Madagascar has a Digital Strategic Plan (PSN) 2023-2028 focused on developing telecommunications and digitizing public services. Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Madagascar's data exchange platform 'Rahaka', based on X-Road (Estonian open-source), is partially operational. The Digital Governance Unit (UGD/DGU) launched it under the World Bank PRODIGY project. As of 2022, data interoperability between the tax directorate, commerce registry, and statistics agencies was operational (enabling business registration in 8 hours). As of August 2025, UGD was seeking consulting support to scale up operationalization, indicating it is functional but not fully deployed.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Madagascar's DGU is developing the Mahatoky service to provide digital services through post offices for citizens with low connectivity. Internet penetration is ~20% of the population. The Torolalana portal serves the digitally connected 20% only; postal channel under development for broader inclusion.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Madagascar has Law No. 2014-038 on Protection of Personal Data (enacted 2015), though implementing decrees are not yet fully published. CMIL (data protection authority) was established by Decree No. 2023-1541 (Dec 2023). Madagascar ratified the Malabo Convention in June 2024. X-Road/Rahaka includes technical data protection features (encryption, audit logs). However, full enforcement machinery is not yet operational.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Only 20.6% internet penetration, heavily concentrated in urban areas. Only 33% electricity access nationally (15% in rural areas). The DGU acknowledges that the Torolalana portal only serves 20% of the population with internet access. The government has launched connectivity programs for 1,600+ villages but coverage remains primarily urban.
